title: AI边界模糊：化工、工业、公用事业，都算AI？
speaker: Anthony Stevens

segments.en: And I think my question to you then is, as you look at your portfolio, how much of that is directly or indirectly AI? And what portion of that is not related to AI? Yeah, I mean, this is an interesting question.
segments.zh: 那么我的问题是：看你的组合，多少直接或间接与AI相关？多少与AI无关？这是个有趣的问题。

segments.en: And the other problem with this is, what is and what is an AI started to change, right? You get chemical companies that are very specialized, industrial companies that are building data centers, even utilities, right?
segments.zh: 另一个问题是，AI的定义开始变化。比如专业化工公司、建设数据中心的工业公司，甚至公用事业，都算AI吗？

segments.en: So I think it's a little bit harder to say what that is and what that isn't compared to sort of in history. But I tell you the way I sort of look at it is, you know, if you say...
segments.zh: 所以与历史上相比，更难界定什么是AI、什么不是。但我看待的方式是，如果你说……
